description: a wiry young woman with short black hair in a black cloak of layered raven feathers, a black raven-beak half mask over the upper face, a dark fitted leather jerkin, dark trousers and soft dark boots, no weapons, sitting upright in the saddle, not crouching or kneeling, sitting astride and riding in the pose of the grey mannequin, both hands in front holding the reins, seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, the face, chest and hips turned to the right and not towards the viewer, sitting sideways in the saddle like the finished rider, only the near leg showing and the far leg hidden behind the horse, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the foot inside the image, nothing under the rider, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what is carried
the pose, size and place of the figure: sitting astride a saddle that is not drawn, seen from the side, facing right, both hands in front holding the reins, only the near leg showing; copy it exactly
a finished rider of the game in the right pose: copy how it sits, seen exactly from the side in profile, the head, chest and hips turned to the right, one leg showing; not its clothes or colours
